title: Combining tests with AND and OR in suppliers

steps.title: Two tests joined by AND
steps.prompt: AND means BOTH tests must be true for a row to stay.
steps.task: Try typing: SELECT id FROM suppliers WHERE name = 'Atlas Supply 1' AND id = 1;
hints: Start with SELECT id FROM suppliers.
Add WHERE name = …
Join with AND id = …
Write: SELECT id FROM suppliers WHERE name = 'Atlas Supply 1' AND id = 1;
steps.expected_sql: SELECT id FROM suppliers WHERE name = 'Atlas Supply 1' AND id = 1;
steps.memory_trick: AND = both; OR = either.
